reason: Feasibility/schedule lens: it passes, with conditions. It is a finals-choice rule plus a CPU script (numpy MC, about 30 lines, already in the session scratchpad as finals_mc.py/finals_mc2.py). It touches no pipeline code, so byte-identical-when-off holds trivially (the off state is v3 section f), and it adds 0 hidden-run time, 0 GPU and 0 LB slots of its own. Calibration inputs exist: the exp60 lab (shard A pushed 17:15 UTC, B queued) has arms ins35, forkmid45 and dc0.15-0.35 per embryo and per SELECTION/CONFIRMATION group (tools/trainlab.py line 72). Four real problems, all fixable: (1) Governance. CONTEXT.md 25 Sep 13:38 UTC says sections e/f are BINDING, 'apply mechanically, do not rewrite'. Replacing F2 = exp52 is an amendment that needs a new explicit user OK. An agent may not adopt it on its own, and the night-research OK does not cover rule changes. (2) Freeze time. The idea freezes the table and script 'before 27 Sep 12:00' (R8), but K3/K3b go in 26 Sep 10-14 UTC and are scored about 17-21 UTC 26 Sep. Freezing on 27 Sep would happen after rider public scores are visible, which is exactly the forking path the pre-registration exists to prevent. (3) Case (2) depends on a scored no-insertion twin (exp58n, idea noins-twin-f2). That costs 1 slot, about 0.5 GPU-h of dummy and 6.5-7 h of latency, and it is not in the pre-approved list (K2/K3/K3b/K4/N1). It fits the schedule: S3 is held in branch A and S9-S11 are free, but it needs the OK. If F1-final later adds riders, the twin differs by more than the insertion (MC P(>X) about 0.93 instead of 0.95; still acceptable). (4) 'Run once 28 Sep 22:00 UTC' misses the S17 emergency rerun (29 Sep <= 02:00, scored about 09-10 UTC), and 22:00 UTC is 01:00 MSK for the user. The tempfuse (T) row cannot be calibrated: the lab has no T arm, so it is a pure prior. 44b6 has only 11 GT divisions, so |d44b6 - d6bba| is noise-dominated. That only inflates sd, which is conservative.
fix: (a) Ask the user tonight or at wake-up for an explicit AMENDMENT OK to section f. Log it in CONTEXT.md as 'PRE-REGISTRATION v3 amendment f2'. (b) Freeze the rule text, tools/finals_mc.py (commit it; seeded, 400k draws) and the prior table BEFORE the first rider submission, i.e. by 26 Sep ~09:00 UTC, not 27 Sep 12:00. After that, only the exp60 numbers are plugged in by the frozen formula (sd = max(prior, |d44b6 - d6bba|) on SEL+CONF; mean = 0.5 x public delta). T keeps its prior. (c) Write a fail-soft clause: if the script errors, an input is missing, or no admissible x138-family pair exists, fall back to v3 section f verbatim (exp52). (d) Get the user's OK for exp58n (noins twin): submit in S3 26 Sep ~00:30-01:00 UTC after its dummy gate (node rows == K2 dummy, counters == K2, edges differ only at inserted forks), or at the latest in S9 on 27 Sep. Rebuild it as exp59n only if forkmid enters F1. (e) Run the script after the LAST score, deadline 29 Sep 16:00 UTC. It prints the two submission IDs plus sha256 checks (not byte-identical, not exp56). The user ticks by 20:00.
realistic_gain: 0 on public, 0 hidden runtime, about 1-1.5 agent-hours plus 1 LB slot and about 0.5 GPU-h for the twin that case (2) needs. On private, the MC (independent-normal guesses) gives +0.02..+0.08 P(finishing above X, the bronze cliff) vs the exp52 default. The feasibility lens cannot verify that number; it only confirms the rule can be implemented and scheduled in time, provided the user OKs the amendment and the freeze moves to 26 Sep ~09:00 UTC.
